race.comment: CHIEF OF STAFF (4) should be ready to go now third up. He hasn't lived up to his breeding to date but is getting to the right trip now. Will be getting a sweet run all the way so needs to take advantage of it early. UNDER TWENTY TWO (3) got the job done first up this track before just missing here again. Probably will be giving away a bit of ground early but be strong through the line. AYE AYE SKIPPER (5) has been some time out of the winner's list but runs the odd good race. HE'S GODSPEED (2) raced on the pace from a wide draw last time over 1300m at Taree then tired late to finish seventh. In the mix on best.
